name: Glizano Redactor Inmobiliario
author: glizano

sections.description:
Glizano Redactor Inmobiliario adds a box to your property editor. One click turns the data you already entered (fields, features, location, current text) into:

  • A title, a 2 to 3 paragraph description and a meta description in Spanish.
  • The same in English, adapted for foreign buyers, keeping your figures and units.
  • A short list of missing data that would improve the listing.
  • If you use Yoast SEO or Rank Math, one click puts the meta description in their field (it is saved when you save the property).

Built for Spanish-speaking real estate agencies. It reads the property’s custom fields (including Advanced Custom Fields and the fields stored by real estate plugins and themes), its taxonomies and its current text, so it also works on sites that keep everything in the post content. You choose which content type holds your properties.

Tested with Estatik and Easy Property Listings: it uses their own formatting for price (with your currency) and areas (with your unit).

Accuracy rules: the text uses only the data in your listing. It does not invent features, distances, views or investment claims. You always review the text before publishing.

Plans: 5 descriptions per month for free. Up to 400 descriptions per month with the Pro plan (15 USD per month), billed by Polar.

Descripción en español: Glizano Redactor Inmobiliario genera con IA el título, la descripción y la meta descripción de tus propiedades, en español e inglés, usando solo los datos de tu anuncio. 5 descripciones gratis al mes; hasta 400 al mes con el plan Pro de 15 USD al mes.

External services

This plugin connects to the Redactor Inmobiliario service to generate texts. Nothing is sent until an administrator accepts it on the settings page.

  • When you click “Generar con IA”, the plugin sends the data of the property you are editing (title, public taxonomies, custom fields except contact details, coordinates and internal fields, and the current text) and a random installation identifier. The service sends those data to Anthropic (Claude) to write the text and returns the result.
  • When you request an access key, the plugin sends the email address you type. The key is delivered to that email.
  • On the settings page, the plugin asks the service for your plan and monthly usage.
  • “Pasar al plan Pro” opens a checkout page by Polar (polar.sh).

Service terms: https://redactor.glizano.dev/terminos
Privacy policy: https://redactor.glizano.dev/privacidad
Anthropic: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
Polar: https://polar.sh/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings > Glizano Redactor Inmobiliario and accept the data sending terms.
  3. Request your access key with your email, paste it and save.
  4. Choose the content type of your properties.
  5. Open a property, save it as a draft and click “Generar con IA”.
sections.faq:
Does it invent features?

It is instructed to use only the data present in the listing and is tested against that rule. AI can still make mistakes, so review every text before publishing.

Which data is sent?

Only the property you are editing, when you ask for it. Contact details, coordinates and internal fields are not sent. See “External services”.
